About our brand and products:
CADDYBAR™ is a modular accessory system designed for golf carts and low-speed vehicles. Our products help customers organize, customize, and get more use out of their carts with accessories such as trays, cup holders, phone and tablet mounts, coolers, scorecard holders, and more.

What makes us different:
Unlike traditional golf cart accessories that are permanently mounted or limited to one use, CADDYBAR™ creates a flexible mounting platform that allows customers to easily add, remove, and reposition accessories. Our system is designed to be clean, functional, durable, and adaptable to a wide variety of golf carts.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commissions by referring customers to CADDYBAR™ through their unique affiliate link. When a qualifying purchase is made through that link, the sale is tracked and the affiliate earns a commission.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote CADDYBAR™ through social media, videos, golf cart groups and communities, websites, email, word of mouth, local demonstrations, or by simply sharing their unique referral link with friends and customers. We also provide approved marketing materials to help make promotion easy.

Other information:
Our affiliate program is currently in beta as we continue to improve the experience for our partners. We encourage affiliates to share feedback, ideas, and opportunities with us. CADDYBAR™ may also provide select affiliates with additional marketing support, promotional materials, or partnership opportunities based on performance and fit.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are paid monthly, typically by the 15th of each month for all approved commissions from the previous month.

CADDYBAR™ Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: 08/12/2026

These CADDYBAR™ Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) govern participation in the CADDYBAR™ Affiliate Program (“Program”) offered by Partee Group LLC (“CADDYBAR™,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”).

By registering for, participating in, or accepting benefits under the Program, you (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”) acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms.

The Program is administered using the UpPromote affiliate and referral marketing platform. UpPromote provides certain tracking, attribution, reporting, coupon, referral, and payment-processing functionality; however, participation in the Program creates an agreement between Affiliate and Partee Group LLC, not between Affiliate and UpPromote.

1. Program Purpose

The CADDYBAR™ Affiliate Program allows approved customers, brand advocates, individuals, organizations, golf professionals, golf clubs, leagues, communities, businesses, and other participants to earn commissions or rewards by referring new customers who purchase eligible CADDYBAR™ products.

Participation does not create an employment relationship, partnership, joint venture, franchise, agency relationship, or exclusive relationship between Affiliate and CADDYBAR™.

Affiliates act solely as independent participants in the Program.

2. Eligibility and Enrollment

To participate, Affiliate must:

  • Be at least 18 years old or the legal age of majority in Affiliate's jurisdiction;
  • Provide accurate and complete registration information;
  • Maintain valid contact and payment information;
  • Comply with these Terms and all applicable laws and regulations; and
  • Use referral links, discount offers, promotional materials, and other Program resources only as permitted by CADDYBAR™.

CADDYBAR™ reserves the right to approve, reject, suspend, or terminate participation in the Program at its discretion, subject to applicable law.

Existing CADDYBAR™ customers may be invited to participate in the Program and may receive access to referral links, offers, or other Program benefits.

Participation is voluntary.

3. Referral Links and Promotional Offers

Affiliates may receive one or more unique referral links, discount offers, referral codes, or other tracking mechanisms through UpPromote.

These tools are intended solely to identify legitimate customers referred by Affiliate.

Affiliate may share approved referral links and promotional materials through appropriate channels, including:

  • Email;
  • Text or direct communication where legally permitted;
  • Social media;
  • Websites or blogs;
  • Golf clubs, leagues, communities, events, or organizations; and
  • Other lawful promotional channels approved by CADDYBAR™.

Affiliate may not alter, manipulate, circumvent, or interfere with CADDYBAR™ or UpPromote tracking technology.

4. Anti-Leak and Coupon Protection

CADDYBAR™ may use UpPromote anti-leak discounts, tracked referral links, automatically applied discounts, dynamic promotional offers, or other technologies designed to protect referral attribution and prevent unauthorized distribution of promotional codes.

Affiliate may not:

  • Publish referral codes on coupon aggregation websites without written authorization;
  • Submit CADDYBAR™ codes to coupon, discount, deal, or promotional databases;
  • Encourage third parties to distribute codes outside Affiliate's intended audience;
  • Misrepresent a public promotional code as Affiliate's exclusive offer;
  • Use unauthorized CADDYBAR™ discount codes;
  • Purchase or bid on CADDYBAR™, CADDYBAR-related trademarks, or confusingly similar terms in paid search advertising without written permission;
  • Use browser extensions, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, redirects, adware, automated traffic, or similar mechanisms to obtain attribution improperly; or
  • Engage in conduct designed primarily to capture commission on customers Affiliate did not genuinely refer.

CADDYBAR™ may reject commissions, suspend an Affiliate account, disable referral links or coupons, or terminate participation where coupon leakage, attribution manipulation, fraud, or abuse is reasonably suspected.

5. Qualified Referrals

A “Qualified Referral” is a completed purchase that:

  1. Is properly attributed to Affiliate through the Program's tracking system;
  2. Is placed by a legitimate customer;
  3. Meets the applicable Program requirements;
  4. Has been fully paid;
  5. Has not been cancelled, returned, refunded, disputed, or charged back; and
  6. Is not otherwise excluded under these Terms.

CADDYBAR™ and the tracking records maintained through UpPromote will determine referral attribution, subject to correction for identifiable technical errors.

A click, lead, registration, abandoned cart, or unpaid order does not constitute a Qualified Referral unless CADDYBAR™ expressly provides otherwise.

6. Self-Referrals

Unless expressly permitted in writing by CADDYBAR™, Affiliates may not earn commissions on their own purchases.

This includes purchases made:

  • By Affiliate;
  • Using Affiliate's own payment method;
  • Primarily for Affiliate's personal benefit;
  • Through another account controlled by Affiliate; or
  • Through artificial or coordinated transactions intended to generate commission.

CADDYBAR™ may review related customer information, payment information, shipping information, account activity, or other available indicators when determining whether a transaction constitutes an improper self-referral.

Legitimate referrals involving family members, friends, colleagues, or organizations are permitted provided the referred purchaser is a genuine independent customer and the transaction is not structured primarily to generate Affiliate compensation.

7. Commissions

Affiliate will earn commissions according to the commission structure displayed in Affiliate's Program dashboard or otherwise communicated by CADDYBAR™.

Commission rates may be based on:

  • A percentage of eligible sales;
  • A fixed amount per Qualified Referral;
  • Tiered performance levels;
  • Specific products or promotions; or
  • Other incentive structures established by CADDYBAR™.

Unless otherwise stated, commissions are calculated on the eligible product purchase amount after discounts and exclude:

  • Shipping and delivery charges;
  • Sales taxes;
  • Duties;
  • Fees;
  • Gift cards;
  • Returned products;
  • Refunded amounts; and
  • Other excluded charges identified by CADDYBAR™.

CADDYBAR™ may change commission rates or Program incentives prospectively at any time.

Changes will not reduce commissions already earned and approved before the effective date of the change, except where an underlying transaction is later refunded, charged back, determined to be fraudulent, or otherwise becomes ineligible.

8. Referral Review and Approval

Referral transactions may initially appear as pending while CADDYBAR™ verifies that the transaction qualifies for commission.

CADDYBAR™ may establish a reasonable holding or validation period before approving commissions to account for:

  • Product returns;
  • Order cancellations;
  • Payment disputes;
  • Chargebacks;
  • Fraud screening;
  • Duplicate attribution;
  • Coupon abuse; or
  • Other transaction irregularities.

Only approved commissions are eligible for payment.

If an order is cancelled, refunded, returned, charged back, determined to be fraudulent, or otherwise becomes ineligible, the related commission may be cancelled or deducted from future Affiliate earnings.

9. Payments

Approved Affiliate commissions will be paid according to the payout schedule, minimum payout threshold, and payment methods established by CADDYBAR™ and displayed within the Program or Affiliate dashboard.

Available payment methods may be provided through UpPromote or compatible third-party payment providers.

Affiliate is responsible for maintaining accurate payment information.

CADDYBAR™ is not responsible for delays or failed payments caused by:

  • Incorrect payment information supplied by Affiliate;
  • Affiliate's failure to establish or maintain a required payment account;
  • Payment-provider restrictions;
  • Bank or payment-network delays;
  • Affiliate's failure to provide required tax documentation; or
  • Circumstances beyond CADDYBAR™'s reasonable control.

CADDYBAR™ may withhold payment while investigating suspected fraud, Program violations, returns, chargebacks, or disputed referrals.

10. Taxes

Affiliate is solely responsible for all federal, state, local, and other taxes resulting from commissions, rewards, or other compensation received through the Program.

Affiliate agrees to provide any reasonably required tax information or documentation, including a Form W-9, W-8BEN, or other applicable documentation.

Where required, CADDYBAR™ or its payment or platform provider may issue applicable tax reporting documentation.

11. Affiliate Marketing Disclosures

Affiliate must clearly and conspicuously disclose Affiliate's financial relationship with CADDYBAR™ whenever Affiliate endorses, recommends, reviews, or promotes CADDYBAR™ products in circumstances where such disclosure is required.

Appropriate disclosures may include language such as:

“I may earn a commission if you purchase through my link.”

or

“CADDYBAR™ Affiliate — I may earn a commission from qualifying purchases.”

The disclosure must be reasonably noticeable to consumers and positioned in connection with the endorsement or recommendation.

Affiliate is responsible for complying with all Federal Trade Commission endorsement requirements and all other applicable advertising, consumer-protection, social-media, email, text-message, privacy, and marketing laws.

Affiliate may not make false, misleading, deceptive, unsupported, or unsubstantiated claims regarding CADDYBAR™ or its products.

12. Promotional Standards

Affiliate must represent CADDYBAR™ professionally and accurately.

Affiliate may not promote CADDYBAR™ through content that:

  • Is fraudulent, deceptive, misleading, or defamatory;
  • Contains unlawful, hateful, discriminatory, obscene, or abusive material;

Affiliate must discontinue or correct promotional content upon reasonable request from CADDYBAR™.

13. Email, SMS, and Direct Marketing

Affiliate is solely responsible for ensuring that any email, SMS, direct message, or similar marketing activity complies with applicable laws and platform requirements.

Affiliate may not:

Affiliate is responsible for obtaining any legally required consent before sending promotional communications.

14. Intellectual Property

Participation in the Program provides Affiliate with a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use approved CADDYBAR™ marketing materials solely for purposes of participating in the Program.

  • Modify CADDYBAR™ trademarks or logos without permission;

All goodwill arising from Affiliate's permitted use of CADDYBAR™ intellectual property benefits Partee Group LLC.

15. Confidentiality

Affiliate agrees to keep confidential any non-public business, pricing, product, customer, technical, marketing, financial, or strategic information disclosed by CADDYBAR™.

Affiliate may use confidential information only for legitimate participation in the Program and may not disclose it to third parties except where authorized by CADDYBAR™ or required by law.

Affiliate may not independently collect, retain, sell, transfer, or misuse personal information obtained through CADDYBAR™ or the Program.

Customer information must be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and CADDYBAR™ policies.

17. Independent Contractor Status

Affiliate is an independent contractor and not an employee, agent, representative, partner, franchisee, or joint venturer of CADDYBAR™.

Affiliate:

  • Is responsible for Affiliate's own expenses; and

Nothing in these Terms guarantees Affiliate any minimum level of commissions, referrals, income, or compensation.

18. No Earnings Guarantee

Affiliate earnings depend on actual Qualified Referrals and compliance with these Terms.

Past results of other Affiliates do not guarantee future results.

19. Fraud and Abuse

CADDYBAR™ maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward referral fraud.

Prohibited activities include, without limitation:

  • Cookie stuffing;
  • Automated clicks or traffic;
  • Misleading redirects;
  • Unauthorized coupon distribution;
  • Manipulation of tracking technology;

  • Artificial generation of leads or purchases;

  • Any attempt to obtain commission for a transaction Affiliate did not legitimately influence.

CADDYBAR™ may investigate any transaction or account activity and may reject, reverse, or withhold commissions reasonably associated with suspected fraud or Program abuse.

20. Returns, Refunds, and Chargebacks

Commissions are earned only on completed and retained sales.

If a referred order is subsequently:

  • Partially or fully refunded;
  • Subject to a payment dispute;
  • Charged back; or
  • Determined to be fraudulent,

the corresponding commission may be cancelled, reduced, reversed, or deducted from future commissions.

Where only part of an order is refunded or returned, the commission may be adjusted proportionately.

21. Program Modification

CADDYBAR™ may modify the Program, including commission rates, referral incentives, discounts, promotional rules, qualification requirements, payment schedules, and Program features.

Material changes will apply prospectively except where immediate changes are reasonably necessary to address:

Continued participation after updated Terms become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

Upon termination, Affiliate must stop using all CADDYBAR™ referral links, promotional codes, confidential materials, and intellectual property except as otherwise permitted by law.

Legitimately earned and approved commissions through the termination date will remain payable, except commissions associated with fraud, prohibited conduct, refunds, chargebacks, or other violations of these Terms.
